We recognise the growing focus on climate change and sustainability driven
by the regulatory requirements already in place, the enhanced disclosure
requirements and the expectations of various stakeholders on green
initiatives may require us to alter our strategy and or business model. In
addition, we continue to build ESG sensitivities and requirements in to our
strategic risk framework to better enhance both our commitment towards
mitigating climate change and strengthening our reliance.

Talent related challenges with regards to upskilling existing employees,
attracting and retaining new staff in specialised roles such as information
technology and in our digital banking division were a key focus in 2024. In
addition, challenging economic environment are also correlated with
increased risk of internal fraud. While the former continues to pressure the
cost of operating the latter increases the risk of financial loss. In response to
the skilling our workforce, we have accelerated our investment in our staff
training and upskilling. We also continue to strengthen our fraud risk
detection capabilities and staff awareness.
